sections.heading: 1. Definitions and Confidential Information
sections.body:
1.1 For the purposes of this Agreement, "Confidential Information" means any and all non-public information, data, know-how, trade secrets, business plans, financial information, technical data, or other proprietary information disclosed by either party (the "Disclosing Party") to the other party (the "Receiving Party"), whether disclosed orally, in writing, electronically, or by any other means, and whether or not marked as "confidential" at the time of disclosure.

1.2 Confidential Information shall not include information that: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; (b) was rightfully known to the Receiving Party prior to disclosure by the Disclosing Party, as evidenced by written records; (c) is rightfully received by the Receiving Party from a third party without restriction on disclosure; or (d) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of or reference to the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.

1.3 The parties acknowledge that this Agreement is mutual and that each party may act as both a Disclosing Party and a Receiving Party at different times during the term of this Agreement.

sections.heading: 2. Obligations of Confidentiality and Permitted Use
sections.body:
2.1 Each Receiving Party agrees to: (a) hold the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information, but in no event less than reasonable care; (b) not disclose the Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party; (c) use the Confidential Information solely for the purpose of evaluating or pursuing a potential business relationship or transaction between the parties (the "Permitted Purpose"); and (d) limit access to the Confidential Information to its employees, directors, advisors, or contractors who have a need to know such information for the Permitted Purpose and who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those set out herein.

2.2 Each Receiving Party shall promptly notify the Disclosing Party upon becoming aware of any actual or suspected unauthorised disclosure or use of the Confidential Information.

2.3 Compelled Disclosure: If a Receiving Party is required by applicable law, regulation, or order of a competent court or governmental authority to disclose any Confidential Information, it shall, to the extent permitted by law: (a) provide the Disclosing Party with prompt prior written notice of such requirement; (b) cooperate with the Disclosing Party in seeking a protective order or other appropriate relief; and (c) disclose only that portion of the Confidential Information that is legally required to be disclosed.

2.4 Upon written request by the Disclosing Party, or upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy (and certify such destruction in writing) all tangible materials containing or embodying the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law.

sections.heading: 3. Term and Termination
sections.body:
3.1 This Agreement shall commence on the date last signed below (the "Effective Date") and shall remain in force for a period of two (2) years from the Effective Date, unless earlier terminated by either party upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the other party.

3.2 The confidentiality obligations set out in Clause 2 shall survive the expiry or termination of this Agreement and shall continue to bind the parties for a period of two (2) years following such expiry or termination.

3.3 Termination of this Agreement shall not affect any rights or obligations that have accrued prior to the date of termination.

sections.heading: 4. General Provisions
sections.body:
4.1 Governing Law and Jurisdiction: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located at [TO BE CONFIRMED: city/seat of jurisdiction in India, e.g., Mumbai, Delhi, or Bengaluru].

4.2 No Licence: Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as granting either party any licence, right, title, or interest in or to the other party's Confidential Information, intellectual property, or any other proprietary rights, whether by implication, estoppel, or otherwise.

4.3 No Warranty: All Confidential Information is provided "as is." Neither party makes any representation or warranty, express or implied, as to the accuracy, completeness, or fitness for a particular purpose of any Confidential Information disclosed hereunder.

4.4 Entire Agreement and Amendments: This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions, representations, and agreements relating thereto. This Agreement may not be amended except by a written instrument signed by authorised representatives of both parties.

4.5 Severability: If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable under applicable law, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.

4.6 Waiver: No failure or delay by either party in exercising any right under this Agreement shall operate as a waiver of that right.

4.7 Counterparts: This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, including by electronic signature, each of which shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement as of the Effective Date.

The Permitted Purpose (evaluating or pursuing a potential business relationship) is a standard placeholder. The drafter should confirm and specify the actual commercial purpose between the parties.
The seat/city of jurisdiction under Indian law has been left as [TO BE CONFIRMED]. The drafter must specify the city (e.g., Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru) to make the jurisdiction clause enforceable.
The full legal names of both parties are not supplied and have been left as [TO BE CONFIRMED] in the signature block. These must be confirmed before execution.

The survival period for confidentiality obligations post-termination has been set at two (2) years, matching the agreement term. The drafter should confirm this is commercially acceptable to both parties.

No deal value or industry-specific provisions were supplied; none have been assumed. If the parties operate in a regulated sector (e.g., financial services, healthcare, defence), additional sector-specific carve-outs or obligations may be required.
Electronic signature is permitted under Clause 4.7. If either party requires wet-ink signatures only, this clause should be amended.
The notice period for early termination has been set at 30 days as a reasonable default. The drafter should confirm this is agreed by both parties.

No specific remedies clause (e.g., injunctive relief) has been included given the instruction to keep the NDA short (at most 4 sections). If the parties wish to expressly reserve the right to seek injunctive relief without bond, a sentence should be added to Clause 2.
